text.debian: Download the latest package lists with `apt update`.
text.arch: Synchronize the package database and upgrade the system with `pacman -Syu`.
text.redhat: Fetch new package information and check for updates with `dnf check-update`.

hint.debian: The command changes the system and requires root: `sudo apt update`.
hint.arch: The command changes the system and requires root: `sudo pacman -Syu`.
`sudo pacman -S tree` and answer yes to the question.
hint.redhat: `sudo dnf install tree` – and answer `y`, since No is the default!

hint.debian: After `sudo apt update`, run `sudo apt upgrade`.
hint.arch: `sudo pacman -Syu` does it all in one go.

vim.text: Bonus: install the Vim text editor. Hint: the package doesn't have the same name in every family!

hint.debian: Search with `apt search vim`. The package is called `vim`.
hint.arch: Search with `pacman -Ss vim`. The package is called `vim`.
hint.redhat: Search with `dnf search vim`. The package is called `vim-enhanced`.
